title: Activate M3.2 factory paths in Learn-it Next CI trigger
purpose: Make the already-governed M3.2 AI Kit Factory delegated route reachable by adding only the exact factory and skill paths to the Learn-it Next CI pull_request and push filters.
invariants: Only the Learn-it Next CI workflow and this work-package file may change.
Routing semantics introduced by CI-WP-007 remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Only event path filters are extended.
Both pull_request and push filters include authoring/factory/**.
Both pull_request and push filters include exactly the two M3.2 skill files.
Existing authoring/v2, learner and contracts triggers remain unchanged.
Every other unknown product branch remains fail-closed.
No product, test, contract or branch-protection behavior is changed.
requiredEvidence: Learn-it Next CI exact-head routed matrix PASS on the CI-only branch.
Static proof that the three M3.2 trigger entries occur in both PR and push filters.
Static proof that the CI-WP-007 m3-2-factory-delegated route block is unchanged from base.
adversarialTests: Factory-only product delta must trigger Learn-it Next CI.
Either M3.2 skill file alone must trigger Learn-it Next CI.
Removing the factory trigger from PR or push is a failure.
Changing the m3-2-factory-delegated route logic is a failure.
Changing any non-workflow path outside CI-WP-008 metadata is a failure.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope gate the two-file CI change.
The existing Learn-it Next CI self-test/routed matrix must pass on the exact CI head.
rollback: Revert the three M3.2 path-filter additions and CI-WP-008 metadata. The route then becomes unreachable again but all product code remains unchanged.
